decisions.why: Benevision N-series and High Acuity monitors are specialist (high-acuity ward/ICU) patient monitors
A-Series workstations (A9, A8) with vaporizers are anaesthesia machines
explicitly named anaesthesia machines (A9 High Acuity Anesthesia Machine) with vaporizer accessories
chemistry and haematology analysers (Ba 800M, Bs 480, Bc 3600, 5-part differential analyzers) are laboratory analysers & equipment
